column1: # p347 — the POLICY channel, measured rather than assumed.  p345 recorded that every EU
# domain returns HTTP 000 and labelled its AI Act date resolution a CONVERGENCE OF SECONDARY
# SOURCES that may not be cited as a verified read.  This pass tested whether a SECOND,
# independent fetch channel reaches any of them.  It does not.
# 🔴 So the uncertainty is STRUCTURAL, not a channel choice: curl fails at the TLS/proxy layer
# (HTTP 000) and the WebFetch channel fails at DNS (getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND) on the same hosts.
# 🟢 The consequence for this base: every regulatory date on these shelves stays labelled as
# search-channel convergence, and `gate-dates` remains the only thing standing between a
# stale date and an EMEA client.  Its pinned values are the ones to keep quoting:
# Annex III education duties 2027-12-02; Article 50 transparency live 2026-08-02.
